description: Super-Resolution for Renewable Energy Resource Data with Climate Change Impacts (Sup3rCC) is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The Super-Resolution for Renewable Energy Resource Data with Climate Change Impacts (Sup3rCC) data is a collection of 4km hourly wind, solar, temperature, humidity, and pressure fields for the contiguous United States under various climate change scenarios. Sup3rCC is downscaled Global Climate Model (GCM) data. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Renewables, Climate. Its keywords are energy, solar, wind, temperature, GHI, DNI. The portal shows 2024-07-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
